method.accepted: only when the candidate scored better than the baseline
method.frames: voiced frames whose reference RMS is at least 2000; a log-domain measure is meaningless on near-silence
method.scoring: each candidate rendered and compared against the same speech through TMS5200 tables; mel-cepstral distortion over the frame and its successor
method.search: coordinate descent, +/-1 around each nearest-mapped K index, 2 passes
